title: jatropha mollissima var. divergens
intro: Jatropha mollissima var. divergens, commonly known as Jatropha, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae, known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Jatropha include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial effects. The health benefits of Jatropha include reducing pain and inflammation, treating wounds and skin conditions, and providing antioxidant protection against oxidative stress and cell damage.
